capabilities.text: Hold the beam on a pivot anywhere along it
Hold the beam on two supports, A and B
Hang the beam from a wall with a cable at 15° to 75° (a hanging sign)
capabilities.note: Cable is on by default for the wall.

capabilities.text: Fix the beam to a wall with no cable (a cantilever)
capabilities.note: Checked by hand that cable off differs from the wall with a cable.

capabilities.text: Set the beam’s length, drawn to scale
Measure lengths in m or cm
Give the beam its own weight or mass at its middle, or leave it light
Add up to six loads, each at its own place along the beam
Hang a block or a ball from the beam
Rest a load on the beam
Draw a load as a force arrow down or up
Set each object’s size
capabilities.note: From the page’s per-load Size control.

capabilities.text: Give each load’s value in N
Give the loads as masses in kg or g
Use g = 9.8, 9.81 or 10 N/kg for masses
capabilities.note: g shows only in the worked answers. Checked by hand that g changes the kg render with answers on.

capabilities.text: Label every load and distance with its value
capabilities.note: The value labels are the opening state; the tokens show they follow the values.

capabilities.text: Write your own text, such as m_1, x or ?, in a load or distance label
Put a blank line in a load or distance label for students
Leave a load or distance label off
Mark distances from the pivot, support A or the wall
Mark the beam’s whole length
Draw a weight arrow down from every object
Draw the forces holding the beam up
capabilities.note: Ours draws the support forces only with answers on. Token passes on answers alone; checked by hand that the switch adds the pivot force arrow.

capabilities.text: Work out each load’s torque step by step (force × distance)
capabilities.note: Ours prints only the clockwise and counterclockwise totals, not one line per load.

capabilities.text: Work out the total clockwise and counterclockwise torques and whether the beam is balanced
Work out the support forces or the cable tension
capabilities.note: Tokens pass on the support alone; checked by hand that answers change both renders.

capabilities.text: Balance the beam by solving for any one load
capabilities.note: Ours solves for a load only on a pivot (param hint).

capabilities.text: Mirror the figure, so the wall is on the right
Color the figure for slides
